critical_code_review_comments: TechnicalReports.jsx is ~10387 lines — should be split into smaller focused components for maintainability (well over the 700-line guideline).

criar_fs_continuidade in routes/relatorios.py distributes ALL disponivel hours to the FIRST selected intervencao only (loop sets disponivel=0 after first iteration). If admin selects multiple intervencoes intending to split mão-de-obra, all hours go to the first one. This matches the 'simple strategy' comment in code, but consider documenting this more clearly in API response or UI.
criar_fs_continuidade does NOT validate that the chosen intervencoes are not already 'herdada' (could create chain of continuity from a continuity FS). Add explicit check.
criar_fs_continuidade also does NOT validate that chosen intervencoes are not already facturada with continuity (would silently re-facturate and re-create). Worth adding explicit guard.
